captions: [{"start":0.03,"end":4.16,"text":"On July 24th, 2026, more than 270"},{"start":4.16,"end":6.6,"text":"companies and organizations signed an open"},{"start":6.6,"end":8.44,"text":"letter to Washington."},{"start":8.47,"end":11.52,"text":"Microsoft, Nvidia, Meta, and a long list"},{"start":11.52,"end":13.66,"text":"of others urged policymakers not to"},{"start":13.66,"end":16.26,"text":"restrict open-weight AI models."},{"start":16.35,"end":18.36,"text":"The letter is about policy, but it is"},{"start":18.4,"end":20,"text":"really a market signal."},{"start":20.03,"end":21.59,"text":"It is telling you where the profit is"},{"start":21.65,"end":24.49,"text":"moving in the AI economy, and it is not"},{"start":24.57,"end":25.75,"text":"staying in the models."},{"start":25.79,"end":27.51,"text":"That is the question we are going to"},{"start":27.51,"end":27.92,"text":"unpack."},{"start":27.95,"end":30.36,"text":"If capable AI models become open-weight,"},{"start":30.39,"end":31.88,"text":"who keeps the profit?"},{"start":31.91,"end":33.2,"text":"Here is the short answer."},{"start":33.23,"end":35.52,"text":"Value migrates, it does not disappear."},{"start":35.55,"end":37.35,"text":"The model itself is becoming the cheapest"},{"start":37.36,"end":38.64,"text":"part of the stack."},{"start":38.67,"end":40.54,"text":"The money is moving to distribution,"},{"start":40.54,"end":43.17,"text":"workflow ownership, proprietary context,"},{"start":43.17,"end":43.94,"text":"and trust."},{"start":44.03,"end":46.16,"text":"Start with the definition we need."},{"start":46.19,"end":48.34,"text":"An open-weight model is software you can"},{"start":48.34,"end":50.88,"text":"download, inspect, modify, and run on your"},{"start":50.9,"end":52.24,"text":"own infrastructure."},{"start":52.27,"end":54.87,"text":"That means the model is interchangeable."},{"start":55.01,"end":56.67,"text":"If you can run the same capability"},{"start":56.67,"end":59,"text":"anywhere, the model stops being a product"},{"start":59,"end":60.76,"text":"and becomes a raw input."},{"start":60.79,"end":63.33,"text":"The product is the system around it, the"},{"start":63.33,"end":65.49,"text":"workflow that turns the model into a"},{"start":65.49,"end":67.7,"text":"result, the data that makes the result"},{"start":67.7,"end":69.85,"text":"worth something, the distribution that"},{"start":70.21,"end":72.1,"text":"puts it in front of a user, and the trust"},{"start":72.1,"end":73.81,"text":"that keeps them coming back."},{"start":73.87,"end":74.93,"text":"Now follow the money."},{"start":75.11,"end":77.49,"text":"Gartner forecasts worldwide AI spending"},{"start":77.59,"end":82.45,"text":"will reach $2.59 trillion in 2026, up 47%"},{"start":82.55,"end":84.26,"text":"from a year earlier."},{"start":84.29,"end":86.88,"text":"But that spending is not landing evenly."},{"start":86.91,"end":88.6,"text":"The thing to watch is the price of a"},{"start":88.6,"end":91.5,"text":"token, the unit that AI companies sell."},{"start":91.55,"end":93.44,"text":"Token costs are plunging."},{"start":93.47,"end":95.14,"text":"Open-weight models are flooding the"},{"start":95.14,"end":97.43,"text":"market, and every model provider is being"},{"start":97.43,"end":99.7,"text":"forced to cut prices to keep up."},{"start":99.73,"end":101.2,"text":"That is the margin squeeze."},{"start":101.23,"end":103.14,"text":"The model layer is getting cheaper by the"},{"start":103.21,"end":105.09,"text":"quarter, while the layers around it"},{"start":105.09,"end":106.27,"text":"capture more of the value."},{"start":106.43,"end":108.34,"text":"Here is where the market comes in."},{"start":108.39,"end":110.72,"text":"Forbes reported in July that token costs"},{"start":110.72,"end":113.07,"text":"are falling so fast that model providers"},{"start":113.07,"end":114.85,"text":"face a new margin squeeze, while"},{"start":114.85,"end":116.47,"text":"enterprise buyers are shifting their"},{"start":116.47,"end":118.8,"text":"spending toward the application layer."},{"start":118.83,"end":120.92,"text":"The workflow and the data live there."},{"start":120.95,"end":122.64,"text":"That is the durable moat."},{"start":122.67,"end":124.4,"text":"Distribution is scarce."},{"start":124.43,"end":126.08,"text":"Workflow ownership is scarce."},{"start":126.11,"end":128.49,"text":"Proprietary context is scarce."},{"start":128.59,"end":129.65,"text":"The weights are not."},{"start":129.83,"end":132,"text":"So what is the honest uncertainty?"},{"start":132.03,"end":134.18,"text":"The uncertainty is not whether the model"},{"start":134.18,"end":135.6,"text":"gets commoditized."},{"start":135.63,"end":137.32,"text":"That is already happening."},{"start":137.35,"end":138.88,"text":"The uncertainty is which of the"},{"start":138.88,"end":141.01,"text":"surrounding layers turns out to be the"},{"start":141.37,"end":142.14,"text":"durable one."},{"start":142.17,"end":144.46,"text":"Distribution could consolidate around a"},{"start":144.46,"end":145.48,"text":"few platforms."},{"start":145.51,"end":147.51,"text":"Workflow could be owned by incumbents who"},{"start":147.51,"end":149.44,"text":"already sit inside the enterprise."},{"start":149.47,"end":151.56,"text":"Or new context advantages could emerge"},{"start":151.56,"end":153.41,"text":"from the data that only a specific"},{"start":153.77,"end":154.88,"text":"business can collect."},{"start":154.91,"end":157.5,"text":"No one knows which one compounds fastest."},{"start":157.59,"end":158.65,"text":"That is the bet."},{"start":158.75,"end":160.92,"text":"The signal to watch is not the benchmark"},{"start":160.92,"end":161.6,"text":"scores."},{"start":161.63,"end":163.66,"text":"It is the behavior underneath them."},{"start":163.69,"end":165.86,"text":"Watch whether enterprises keep paying for"},{"start":165.86,"end":168.42,"text":"model access or start running open weights"},{"start":168.42,"end":170.26,"text":"on their own infrastructure."},{"start":170.29,"end":172.42,"text":"Watch where the application vendors put"},{"start":172.42,"end":173.38,"text":"their margins."},{"start":173.43,"end":175.25,"text":"Watch whether the biggest winners are the"},{"start":175.25,"end":176.58,"text":"ones who own the workflow, the"},{"start":176.93,"end":178.97,"text":"distribution, and the data, rather than"},{"start":178.97,"end":180.18,"text":"the model itself."},{"start":180.27,"end":182.4,"text":"The AI race was about building the best"},{"start":182.4,"end":182.87,"text":"model."},{"start":183.03,"end":184.92,"text":"Then it was about the cheapest model."},{"start":184.95,"end":187.12,"text":"Now it is about the system that makes the"},{"start":187.12,"end":188.08,"text":"model useful."},{"start":188.11,"end":189.6,"text":"That is the tension."},{"start":189.63,"end":192.92,"text":"And in 2026, it has a number attached."},{"start":192.95,"end":196.36,"text":"$2.59 trillion of spending, a flood of"},{"start":196.36,"end":198.69,"text":"open weights, and a margin squeeze that is"},{"start":198.69,"end":200.53,"text":"telling you exactly where the value is"},{"start":200.63,"end":200.85,"text":"going."},{"start":201.03,"end":203.18,"text":"The question for the next phase of the AI"},{"start":203.18,"end":205.47,"text":"economy is not whether the models get"},{"start":205.53,"end":206.1,"text":"better."},{"start":206.13,"end":208.72,"text":"It is who owns the layers around them."},{"start":208.79,"end":211.17,"text":"The moat is the system, not the model."}]
